The structure of Dy2Sb2Te4 (DySbTe2) is monoclinic, with space group C2/m (No. 194) and a 16-atom unit cell comprising four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Sb and Te each adopt tetrahedral coordination, with Sb–Te and Te–Te distances around 2.76–2.99 Å, while Dy is octahedrally coordinated by six Te neighbors near 3.03 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Corner- and edge-sharing is observed between tetrahedral Te polyhedra, and between octahedral Dy and tetrahedral Te polyhedra.
